in_sanskrit.name: रविचन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ravi means Sun and Chandra means Moon, so Ravi Chandra translates to 'Sun with Moon'. This is a beautiful name that represents the harmony between the Sun and the Moon, symbolizing a balanced and peaceful life.

in_hindi.name: रविचन्द्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ravi (रवि) means Sun and Chandra (चन्द्र) means Moon, so Ravi Chandra (रविचन्द्र) translates to 'Sun with Moon'. This is a beautiful name that represents the harmony between the Sun and the Moon, symbolizing a balanced and peaceful life.

in_tamil.name: ரவிசந்திர
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ravi (ரவி) means Sun and Santhiram (சஹலா) means peace, so Ravichandra (ரவிசந்திர) translates to 'Sun that brings peace'. This is a powerful name that represents the calming and nurturing effects of the Sun.

in_telugu.name: రవిచంద్ర

in_marathi.name: Ravichandra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun God, Moon God
